reddit.title_template: How I use crypto for everyday purchases without converting to fiat

tweets: 5 privacy mistakes you're making with online payments 🧵
1. Using the same card everywhere — if one site gets hacked, all your accounts are at risk
2. Saving cards in browsers — Chrome stores them in plaintext on disk
3. No alerts — you don't know when charges happen
4. Using real name for trials — they charge after 'free' period

5. No virtual cards — the easiest fix for all of the above

Fix it → {site_url}
